info.title: Job API contracts
info.description: Owner-scoped CPU dataset validation and browser-authorized native corpus job projections. Native creation retains its separate wallet-authorized operator workflow. A capability is an observation, not proof of funded capacity or GPU qualification. Public operations exclude worker lease endpoints. Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds. Input encoding is UTF-8 JSONL, not CSV. Job spec pins and source references do not replace the economic task registry.

anyOf.description: Returned once. Replays return null; the service stores only the token hash.

workspaceKey.description: Customer key. Native job projections and operator actions are not key-authorized.

browserSession.name: session
browserSession.description: Existing browser session. Native projections additionally require fresh administrator wallet verification.

RateLimited.description: Owner request limit shared across browser sessions and workspace keys: 240 GET requests and 120 writes per minute. Retry-After is a wait hint; mutations require explicit reconciliation with the original key.

error.message: Too many job requests. Wait before trying again.
